issue.title: just check fails at lint (mypy): prebuild _run_command lacks DevCommandRunner on_output
issue.description:
## CI failure

- **Node:** `lint (mypy): src/sase/dev_update/prebuild.py:134,162`

`just check` (via `sase tool run check`) fails deterministically at `lint (mypy)` with two `[arg-type]` errors in `src/sase/dev_update/prebuild.py`: `produce_prebuild` (line 134) and `consume_prebuild` (line 162) receive `_run_command`, whose signature lacks the `on_output` keyword that the expected `DevCommandRunner` protocol declares. fmt, keep-sorted, and ruff all pass; the failure is in a file unrelated to current bead-read work (unmodified in the working tree).

Why not a flake: mypy is deterministic; the error reproduces on an unmodified file (confirmed the working tree has no changes to `src/sase/dev_update/`), so it fails identically on every run at this SHA.

Fix direction: thread the optional `on_output: Callable[[str, str], None] | None = ...` parameter through `_run_command` (or adapt the two call sites to wrap it), matching the `DevCommandRunner` protocol.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic mypy [arg-type] error on an unmodified file; reproduces identically on every run at this SHA, so it cannot be a flake.

payload.entry: Backlog triage 2026-10-26 (sase 60832648be, sase-core 4121de03): verified FIXED. src/sase/dev_update/prebuild.py:183 _run_command now accepts on_output: OutputSink | None, matching DevCommandRunner; mypy/lint is green in Master Gate 40335100398 at HEAD.
